specificSetting: debate over legitimacy when public institutions invite participation but retain control

tasks.scenario: Two source texts contesting the democratic value of consultation
tasks.purpose: synthesise arguments, assess institutional incentives and establish conditions for legitimacy
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Source texts are original, no reused theses or statistics. Skeleton differs from all previous C2 essays.

tasks.scenario: Review of an exhibition about the architecture of public decision-making
tasks.purpose: evaluate conceptual design, accessibility and political insight
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Exhibition review is unique; no previous test uses this scenario. Lead-in and content points are distinct.

tasks.scenario: Report on trust erosion after a symbolic consultation process
tasks.purpose: analyse causes, consequences and institutional remedies
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Report scenario is original; no previous test uses trust erosion from a consultation. Skeleton and content points are new.

tasks.scenario: Article exploring whether participation without power is worse than no participation
tasks.purpose: test the proposition and distinguish symbolic from consequential voice
tasks.originalitySelfCheck: Article proposition is unique; no previous test uses this exact framing. Skeleton and content points are distinct.

overallOriginalityCheck: All tasks are original, avoid forbidden concepts, and do not reuse scenarios, audiences, content points, or sentence skeletons from any previous test.
